newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy Sept BTP future forges new highs at start.
newsitem.headline: Italy Sept BTP future forges new highs at start.

text.p: The September BTP futures contract on LIFFE went straight for new record highs in early trade, touching 135.84 before pausing.
The Btp future was 21 basis points up at 135.74 by 0750 GMT.
The February 2007 Btp also broke records, having closed the yield spread over the benchmark 10-year Bund to 101 basis points shortly after the start of trade.
The February 2007 Btp was 18 basis points up at 101.60 with a yield of 6.62 percent.
